RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Not estimable from the information provided

An all-male panel can raise questions about representation, but it does not by itself show sex influenced this decision—particularly since you and the successful candidate are both men. That doesn’t rule out bias; it means you need other evidence. A numerical probability would be guesswork.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment and how the appointee met essential requirements. The announcement may omit relevant qualifications; your higher degree doesn’t automatically establish stronger suitability.

Raise panel composition if an applicable policy required balance or other evidence suggests bias. Check local complaint deadlines now; don’t assume awaiting an explanation extends them.
